title: Virtual Compute: primary usage pricing
content:
## Retired clause 1

This former Virtual Compute handling clause is no longer in force: “The negotiated rate replaces the primary standard unit rate before applying the region factor and receives no further discount.” Its basis has been superseded.

## Retired clause 2

This former Virtual Compute handling clause is no longer in force: “No discount applies to taxes, license fees, standalone supplemental services or previously issued credits.” Its basis has been superseded.

## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — This policy and its gate apply only to primary usage source subtype; category-specific primary pricing overrides expressly stated in category-specific metering rules take priority. For source subtype primary, the source meter is posted and identifies the billed resource interval. This gate is inapplicable to other source subtype values. Use the tier recorded for each source service interval. Read standard unit rate and regional rate multiplier for primary usage. Allocate included primary quantity across primary meter sources of the same holding and period in service interval start then original source reference order; prorate it by actual active UTC seconds divided by actual seconds in that UTC calendar month. Only the positive quantity beyond the remaining included allowance is charged. Allocate committed quantity in that same order, splitting covered and uncovered primary quantities into distinguishable invoice lines. The holding commitment must cover the entire source interval to receive commitment discount fraction; a boundary-crossing interval is split at the recorded commitment boundary. For every quantity component choose the first applicable item in primary price selection priority: an approved negotiated rate when permission for an approved negotiated rate, then the committed fraction, then a recorded eligible promotion from eligible campaign channels, then portfolio eligibility, then standard. Promotions and reservations are mutually exclusive. Round the final service subtotal using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention after quantity multiplication, then apply the applicable tax treatment. Record pricing component for each split quantity branch; it is part of the invoice-line identity. Do not apply a billing-period portfolio discount to a partial source interval before the full source period is closed.

## Evidence — posted meter

For charge, For source subtype primary, the source meter is posted and identifies the billed resource interval. This gate is inapplicable to other source subtype values. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using evidence event reference, status, service interval start, service interval end. Those records correlate to the current action by evidence event reference.

## Pricing judgement

The first applicable primary-pricing priority is selected separately for each quantity component. A commitment must cover the entire component interval; intervals crossing its boundary are split.

## Local hypothetical judgement

Hypothetically, no approved negotiated rate applies, a recorded commitment covers the entire quantity interval, and an eligible promotion also exists for that same quantity. Commitment pricing takes priority; the promotion is not combined with it.

superseded_clauses: The negotiated rate replaces the primary unit_rate before applying the region factor and receives no further discount.
No discount applies to taxes, license fees, standalone supplemental services or previously issued credits.
